name: labs/czbiohub-sf__copylot
title: Vortran Stradus laser (copylot VortranLaser)
intro: Vortran Stradus laser (copylot VortranLaser), adapted from czbiohub-sf/copylot. It reads `emission`, `maximum_power`, `fault_code` and `fault_description`; sets `power`, `emission_delay` and `pulse_mode`; runs `emission_on` and `emission_off`. `emission_on`: switch the laser emission on (the upstream turn_on alias, LE=1). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/czbiohub-sf__copylot --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/czbiohub-sf__copylot --backend fake --mcp
